statements.quote: We continue to invest in the future through R&D and Capex spend across our businesses, including SI, robotics and energy.
statements.notes: SI (Super Intelligence) is the company's AI term. It is listed as one of several areas the capex supports, alongside robotics and energy, so AI is a driver of total capex, not a quantified part of it. The present tense 'continue to invest' is read as ongoing actual spend.
